policy.note: the P85 genesis terms of unicity-pos-contracts script/P85Genesis.s.sol (evidenceWindow 1000, holds 2000 rounds, timeFloor 3600 s); the exit maturity is the larger of the hold at the declared round time and the UC-time floor, plus a safety margin

features.governance: queue early, execute late; activation not shown on this chain
features.rewardPool: small separately funded genesis capital, exhaustion then fund()

steps.note: the lane-held authority queues a halved reward rate right after the first snapshot (B6e, gov-lib.sh)
decision (b): the joiner's install into J = K + joiner; labelled 'joiner install + recovery', not an ordinary acknowledged replacement (bft-core#777)
J stalls, then the derived recovery back to K
the held offender's identity asks to exit before its case is submitted; refused for EvidenceHoldPending while the case is admitted and unsettled
the joiner's root key (S4): delivered in epoch 2, submitted and settled after the recovery
root4, a staying member (B4): delivered in epoch 3 with its own evidence window; the later election result is marked lost, the K assignment untouched
2 closed intervals, a pool that runs dry, the refill, a payee's exact claim (B6c); a later interval paid after the refill is not reachable on this chain, see notCovered
refused early for a lawful reason, then matured and claimed with exact amounts after the case settled
execute() after both delays (permissionless, schedules only), then the policy id is polled and the outcome recorded; activation is NOT asserted (see notCovered)
the accounting checker over every snapshot the lane took

steps.uncheckedReason: a restart or outage leaves no durable state to verify afterwards; the command asserts its own recovery (quorum, certified hashes, recovery deadline) and records it in its log; it is NOT restartable, so an interrupted fault fails the campaign

segments.lane: the P85 recovery lane's own shell (ci-lane x4-exit with run-inputs s4, offence2, accounting, rewards, governance), phases at the times the chain dictates; the driver only verifies them (lane steps). About 2 h 10 min.
segments.driver: driver steps on the same accumulated chain after the lane's phases: faults, reconcile. Offsets are from the campaign start, which is the lane's first accounting snapshot.

notCovered.coveredBy: the PoS rehearsal of bft-core#808 and the H6 abort lane (ci-lane kind abort), each on its own fresh state

notCovered.what: a second replacement; an ordinary acknowledged replacement (the lane does the joiner install + recovery, decision (b))
notCovered.coveredBy: the joiner install + recovery in this campaign (bft-core#777, closed as lane wiring)

notCovered.what: an exit by an operator that is not an offender (this lane's one exit is the held offender's, refused on the evidence hold and then claimed)
notCovered.coveredBy: the x4-exit lane without run-inputs s4 (B3b exit steps, bft-core#732 and #774)

notCovered.what: a later reward interval paid after the refill, and 4 closed intervals, on the accumulated chain: RewardPool.closeInterval never closes the latest assignment's tail while an election result is open (pinned contracts b17829ca), so this chain closes 2
notCovered.coveredBy: the shadow-chain x4-rewards lane (bft-core#724); the rule is ristik/unicity-pos-contracts#71, fixed in #72 (merged), which this pin does not include

notCovered.what: governance ACTIVATION of the queued rate: queue and execute (Scheduled) are shown, but after execute + 1800 s the policy id was unchanged with an election result open (run 40071011875)
notCovered.coveredBy: not covered. Cause (dev3's reading of contracts src/p85, not observed on the chain): activation runs only inside ElectionPolicy.elect (activateDue), and elect returns Disabled while any election result is open; this chain has one open from the baseline and after the recovery, so no activation however long it waits. It needs the open session resolved and the next cadence threshold
